youtuber-masks.title: YouTuber & Influencer Face Masks
youtuber-masks.html:
Our YouTuber and influencer face masks bring the biggest names from your feed to the party, from the Sidemen lads and Mr Beast to TikTok favourites, Twitch streamers and golf YouTubers. They’re a hit at charity match watch parties, stag and hen dos, birthdays and gaming nights, and they make brilliant photo booth props.

Every mask is printed in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card at A4 size (297 x 210 mm) in our North Yorkshire workshop. Choose Ready Cut, cut to the face shape with the eye holes done for you, or DIY if you’d rather cut it out yourself. Then pick your fitting: elastic and sticky tabs, or a stick and stickers, supplied for you to attach. Each one is posted flat in a board-backed envelope.

Can’t see your favourite creator? Send us a message and we can make a mask of almost anyone in the public eye.

Please note: these are unofficial novelty masks made for fun and fancy dress. The people shown have not endorsed them, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them.
